title: adonis annua subsp. baetica
intro: Adonis annua subsp. baetica, commonly known as Spanish adonis or adonis baetica, is a subspecies of plant in the genus Adonis and is native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to improve digestion and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Adonis annua subsp. baetica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and cytotoxic activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have also been found to have potential in the prevention and treatment of various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disorders.
